en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, raising it,
‘(He<sup>asws</sup> said): ‘With regards to clipping the nails, begin with the little finger of the left hand, then end with the little finger of the right hand’.
en.sarwar: 16. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr
from in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “When clipping fingernails you must begin with the little finger of the left hand and complete it with the right hand (little fingernail).’”
